transportSources.name: Enbridge Canadian Mainline current tariffs

license.note: Publicly posted regulatory tariff. No general redistribution grant verified.

transportSources.coverage: CER10 Canadian local movement; CER11 joint Canada/US movement. Origin,destination,commodity,service and additionalcharges determine applicability.

transportSources.name: TC Energy Canadian Mainline tariffs

license.note: Public carrier reference. CER-filed documents are authoritative if site differs.

transportSources.update: Monitor daily; fuel ratios have seasonal versions.
transportSources.coverage: Fixed toll settlement through2026-12-31. Toll schedules, abandonment surcharges, rate riders and fuel ratios must be joined.
transportSources.adapter: Download linkedXLS with sheet/header contract and PDF cross-check. Hash tariff index changes. No automatic quote until applicability model verified.
transportSources.publicationGate: Gas demand charges and fuel ratios cannot be treated as oil CAD/m3 volumetric rates.

transportSources.name: Canada internal trade
transportSources.coverage: Federal government explicitly states no tariffs on goods/services crossing internal borders. Permits, standards, prohibitions and administration can still add costs.
transportSources.adapter: Monitor pagehash; editorial review. Do not convert tariff-equivalent economic estimates into payable charges.

transportSources.name: CRA GST/HST for freight carriers
transportSources.update: Monitor daily with general rates table
transportSources.coverage: GST/HST for ordinary domestic freight generally depends on service destination. Continuous inbound/outbound and interlining exceptions may zero-rate.
transportSources.adapter: Dated tax rules table, with explicit service and exception predicates. Keep provincialtaxes/fees outside verifiedGST/HST scope.
transportSources.publicationGate: Tax is not an internal-border tariff. GST/HST is not a complete government-charge total.

transportSources.name: Canadian Transportation Agency freight rail pricing
transportSources.coverage: Public tariffs coexist with negotiated confidential contracts. Actual customer-specific transport prices cannot be reconstructed completely from public tariffs.
transportSources.adapter: Reference only. Show publictariff vs contractquote explicitly.

transportSources.name: NRCan Canadian LNG projects
transportSources.coverage: National overview includes proposed projects and dated expectations. Current page still describes LNGCanada firstexports as future2025.
transportSources.adapter: Manual facility register with source-levelasOf, operating vs proposed and explicit commissioning evidence.
transportSources.publicationGate: Do not infer current operations from a recently crawled page with old content.
